title: One Punch Man OVA
justification: AniList: OVA, 6 episodes of 13 min, 2015-12-24 to 2016-05-27 (TVDB 12 min). AniDB 11123 S1-S6 on 2015-12-24, 2016-01-29, 02-24, 03-25, 04-22, 05-27 (S7-S24 are undated mini theatres and pre-broadcast specials, not in the run). TVDB 293088 season 0 0x2-0x7 on the same dates: 0x2 "The Shadow That Snuck Up Too Close" = S1 Shinobiyori-sugiru Kage; 0x3 "The Disciple Who Sucks at Storytelling" = S2; 0x4 "The Overly-Complicated Ninja" = S3; 0x5 "The Excessively Pushy Bang" = S4; 0x6 "The Sisters With Too Much Going On" = S5; 0x7 "The Far Too Impossible Case of Murder" = S6. 0x1 "Road to Hero" is AniDB 11637. The parent's row (Anime-Lists and overlay/11123.json, which only unmaps S7-S14 and S17) places them there; no other node claims 0x2-0x7 (12430 takes 0x8-0x14, 17576 0x17).
